Run LPEseq2 on pseudo-bulk RNA-seq data generated from a Seurat object

Source: R/LPE_pseudobulk.R
LPE_pseudobulk.Rd

This function creates pseudo-bulk RNA-seq count matrices from an annotated Seurat object and runs LPEseq2 differential expression analysis for each cell type. Pseudo-bulk aggregation can be performed either at the sample level or at the condition level.

Usage

LPE_pseudobulk(
  seurat_obj,
  method = c("sample", "condition"),
  assay = "RNA",
  counts_layer = "counts",
  sample_col = "sample_id",
  condition_col = "condition",
  celltype_col = "celltype",
  celltypes = NULL,
  min_cells = 10,
  normalize_by_ncells = FALSE,
  ncells_scale = 1000,
  normalize.method = c("TMM", "library_size", "DESeq2", "none"),
  log.transform = TRUE,
  min.count = 5,
  prior.count = 1,
  analysis.method = c("auto", "LPE", "standard_anova"),
  standard.min.group.n = 5,
  n.bin = 100,
  df = 10,
  trim.method = c("auto", "dvalue", "iqr", "none"),
  d.threshold = 1.2,
  use_weighted_between = "auto",
  p.method = c("chisq", "F_inf"),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

seurat_obj

A Seurat object containing raw counts and cell-level metadata.

method

Character string specifying the pseudo-bulk aggregation method. One of "sample" or "condition".

assay

Character string specifying the assay to use. Default is "RNA".

counts_layer

Character string specifying the count layer or slot to use. Default is "counts".

sample_col

Character string specifying the metadata column containing sample IDs. Required when method = "sample".

condition_col

Character string specifying the metadata column containing experimental condition or group information.

celltype_col

Character string specifying the metadata column containing cell type annotations.

celltypes

Optional character vector specifying which cell types to analyze. If NULL, all available cell types are analyzed.

min_cells

Integer specifying the minimum number of cells required for a pseudo-bulk sample to be retained. Default is 10.

normalize_by_ncells

Logical. If TRUE, each pseudo-bulk sample's aggregated count vector is divided by its cell count and multiplied by ncells_scale, scaling to a per-ncells_scale-cells basis. This reduces the effect of cell number imbalance across samples. When TRUE, normalize.method is automatically forced to "none" and a warning is issued if the user specifies "TMM" or "DESeq2", because those methods require raw integer counts. Only meaningful when method = "sample". Default is FALSE.

ncells_scale

Positive numeric. Scale factor used when normalize_by_ncells = TRUE. Default is 1000.

normalize.method

Character string specifying the normalization method passed to LPE_preprocess. One of "TMM", "library_size", "DESeq2", or "none". When normalize_by_ncells = TRUE, this is automatically set to "none".

log.transform

Logical. Whether to apply log transformation during preprocessing. Passed to LPE_preprocess.

min.count

Numeric value specifying the minimum count threshold used during preprocessing. Passed to LPE_preprocess. When normalize_by_ncells = TRUE, the count scale changes and this value may need to be adjusted accordingly.

prior.count

Numeric prior count added before log transformation. Passed to LPE_preprocess.

analysis.method

Character string specifying the LPEseq2 analysis method. One of "auto", "LPE", or "standard_anova".

standard.min.group.n

Integer specifying the minimum group sample size required for standard ANOVA when analysis.method = "auto".

n.bin

Integer specifying the number of bins used for intensity-dependent variance trend estimation.

df

Numeric value specifying the degrees of freedom for spline smoothing.

trim.method

Character string specifying the trimming method used during variance trend estimation. One of "auto" (default), "dvalue", "iqr", or "none". "auto" is resolved separately for each cell type by LPE_ANOVA: "none" when every design cell has at least two pseudo-bulk samples, otherwise "dvalue". "dvalue" applies a fixed threshold to the M value (the rescaled pairwise difference actually used for variance estimation), derived from d.threshold as d.threshold/sqrt(2), following LPEseq1's non-replicate outlier procedure (Gim et al. 2016). See LPE_ANOVA_var for details.

d.threshold

Numeric. Threshold on the LPEseq1 raw-D scale, used to derive the fixed M-scale cutoff applied when trim.method = "dvalue" (also when "auto" resolves to it). Default 1.2, matching LPE_ANOVA. Ignored otherwise.

use_weighted_between

"auto" (default), TRUE or FALSE. Whether to use weighted between-group variance information in LPE-ANOVA. "auto" uses FALSE when every design cell has at least two pseudo-bulk samples, otherwise TRUE (see LPE_ANOVA). The setting used for each cell type is reported in the variance_training column.

p.method

Character string specifying the p-value calculation method. One of "chisq" or "F_inf".

verbose

Logical. Whether to print progress messages.

Value

A list containing:

pseudobulk

The full pseudo-bulk object returned by make_pseudobulk_from_seurat.

counts_by_celltype

A list of pseudo-bulk count matrices used for LPEseq2 analysis, split by cell type. When normalize_by_ncells = TRUE, these are cell-number-normalized non-integer matrices.

metadata_by_celltype

A list of pseudo-bulk metadata tables used for LPEseq2 analysis, split by cell type.

prep_by_celltype

A list of preprocessed LPEseq2 objects returned by LPE_preprocess.

results_by_celltype

A list of cell-type-specific differential expression result tables returned by LPE_ANOVA.

combined_result

A combined differential expression result table across all successfully analyzed cell types.

diagnostics

A list of diagnostic summaries, including the number of pseudo-bulk samples, group sizes, cell counts, and library sizes.

errors

A list of errors or skipped-analysis messages for cell types that could not be analyzed.

settings

A list of analysis settings used in the run, including normalize_by_ncells and ncells_scale.

Details

This function first calls make_pseudobulk_from_seurat to generate raw pseudo-bulk count matrices. Each cell type is then analyzed separately using LPE_preprocess and LPE_ANOVA.

The recommended mode for differential expression analysis is method = "sample", because it preserves biological replicates. In contrast, method = "condition" pools cells across all samples within each condition and cell type, usually producing one pseudo-bulk sample per condition. Results from condition-level pseudo-bulk analysis should therefore be interpreted as exploratory.

When normalize_by_ncells = TRUE, pseudo-bulk counts are scaled to a per-ncells_scale-cells basis before LPEseq2 preprocessing. This equalizes the contribution of each sample regardless of the number of cells, which is useful when cell numbers are substantially unequal across samples. Because the resulting values are non-integer, normalize.method is automatically forced to "none" when normalize_by_ncells = TRUE.

See also

make_pseudobulk_from_seurat, LPE_preprocess, LPE_ANOVA

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Standard pseudo-bulk (raw integer counts, TMM normalization)
res <- LPE_pseudobulk(
  seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
  method = "sample",
  sample_col = "sample_id",
  condition_col = "condition",
  celltype_col = "celltype",
  normalize.method = "TMM",
  analysis.method = "auto"
)

# Cell-number-normalized pseudo-bulk
# Use when cell numbers are substantially unequal across samples
res_norm <- LPE_pseudobulk(
  seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
  method = "sample",
  sample_col = "sample_id",
  condition_col = "condition",
  celltype_col = "celltype",
  normalize_by_ncells = TRUE,
  ncells_scale = 1000,
  min.count = 1,
  analysis.method = "auto"
)

neuron_res <- res$results_by_celltype$Neuron
all_res <- res$combined_result
} # }
